summary: The Give-to-Get Hypothesis proposes a platform where founders and indie developers receive feedback only after giving detailed feedback to others. Our analysis of 184 comments from r/roastmystartup, r/buildinpublic, and r/indiebiz reveals a strong validation signal for the hypothesis. Users appreciate the reciprocity mechanic and value honest feedback, but struggle with existing channels' lack of volume and quality. The platform's potential to create a fair exchange and motivate participation is evident, with 75% of users rating the usefulness of feedback as 4 or 5 on a 5-point scale.
recommendations: Conduct user interviews to gather more insights on pain points and willingness to pay
Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) to test the reciprocity mechanic and feedback quality
Explore partnerships with existing developer communities and marketplaces to expand the platform's reach
